conversations_kind_shape.name: conversations_kind_shape
conversations_kind_shape.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'dm' and "conversations"."name" is null and "conversations"."dm_key" is not null)
        or ("conversations"."kind" <> 'dm' and "conversations"."name" is not null and "conversations"."dm_key" is null)

conversations_name_len.name: conversations_name_len
conversations_name_len.value: "conversations"."name" is null or char_length("conversations"."name") between 1 and 80

task_links_title_len.name: task_links_title_len
task_links_title_len.value: "task_links"."title" is null or char_length("task_links"."title") between 1 and 200

tasks_date_range.name: tasks_date_range
tasks_date_range.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."end_date" is null or "tasks"."end_date" >= "tasks"."start_date"
